environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 native image deployed as AWS Lambda behind API Gateway (HTTP API, no throttling configured). Lambda timeout set to 900 seconds (maximum). Memory: 512MB. VPC: default VPC with internet gateway. Concurrency: unreserved (account default 1000). No WAF. API Gateway route: POST /api/v2/validate/* with no request validation or payload size limits beyond the 10MB API Gateway default.
